items.title: Nifty tops 23,800 for the first time since March 2, 2026; Rupee at 6-month high | Closing Bell
items.description:
Join us live for Closing Bell as we break down the action on Dalal Street through the final hour of trade and the close. The Nifty registered its best weekly gain in six years, topping the 23,800 mark for the first time since March 2, with the Sensex and Nifty up over 6% this week and extending their gains for the seventh straight session. All sectors logged weekly gains, with Nifty Realty emerging as the top performer. Dalal Street defied the global AI market rout, and the rupee strengthened to a six-month high of 93.94 against the dollar.

We also track the top Nifty 50 gainers and losers, with ICICI Bank, M&M and Titan among the gainers and Eicher Motors, Power Grid and Adani Enterprises among the laggards, along with the key sectoral trends and the triggers that shaped the day’s trade. Stay tuned for the closing numbers, expert views and what to watch heading into Muhurat trading and the new Samvat.
